E0077

The `#Grant` scope marker is retired.

What

The `#Grant` scope marker is retired.

Why

`#FX` now narrows a block and binds an `Authority` handle when its head has a name.

Fix

Write `#FX(grant: FS, Net) { ... }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0077: tests/ui/retired_grant_marker.stderr.

Error [E0077]: the `#Grant` scope marker is retired
  --> tests/ui/retired_grant_marker.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     #Grant(caps: IO) {
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#FX` now narrows a block and binds an Authority handle when its head has a name
 Fix: write `#FX(grant: FS, Net) { ... }`
